# Rasansky McKenzie Law

> Dallas-based personal injury law firm specializing in medical malpractice, wrongful death, nursing home abuse, birth injuries, and accident claims.

Rasansky McKenzie Law is a prominent Texas personal injury firm founded by Jeff Rasansky and Kolter McKenzie, with attorneys specializing in complex litigation including medical malpractice, birth injuries, nursing home negligence, construction accidents, and vehicle accidents. The firm serves the Dallas-Fort Worth area and is recognized by the American Association for Justice.
